notes.title: Devlope Vlog Update&Share 1
notes.content:
[p][/p][previewyoutube="XImR-xRpTXs;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Hi everyone, long time no see![/p][p]I know many of you have been curious about our progress. As the producer, there’s a lot I’d love to share with you — so let’s treat this video as a casual dev vlog.[/p][p]Over the past year, our team has been fully focused on technological upgrades and iteration.
As some of you may have seen, we recently launched the [b]Nintendo Switch version[/b] of [i]Arisen Force: LifeDevotee[/i] on the Nintendo eShop.[/p][p]This title leverages our latest tech framework, allowing it to run close to [b]60 FPS[/b] on Switch — and for an action game, that smooth framerate is crucial to the player experience.
It’s something we’re incredibly proud of as a team.[/p][p]We’ve also submitted [b]version 1.0.2[/b], which addresses some potential issues, and we expect the update to go live soon.[/p][p]Now, let’s talk about [b]Vonimir[/b].[/p][p]In our latest build, we’ve made significant improvements to character rendering and lighting systems, aiming for full cross-platform support and dynamic lighting effects.
We tackled the challenge of handling complex environment transitions, while still preserving the spatial freedom necessary for both combat and exploration.[/p][p]We also built a range of in-house terrain tools, which dramatically improved the workflow efficiency for constructing the world of Vonimir — making level design much more flexible and efficient.[/p][p]After releasing [i]LifeDevotee[/i] and [i]HeroTest[/i], we realized that for a larger-scale project like Vonimir, continuous tech iteration, workflow optimization, and multi-platform testing are absolutely critical.
That’s why we dedicated this entire year to going back to the fundamentals and refining every layer of our pipeline.[/p][p]Because our whole team has been focused on development, we haven’t had much time for community updates or video content.
But as [i]LifeDevotee[/i] quietly made its debut on Switch, you could say — [b]we prefer to speak through our work[/b].[/p][p]Currently, the [b]PlayStation version[/b] is also in development.
Please continue to believe in us, and support us — thank you, truly, to every warrior of Vonimir![/p][p]In the next vlog, I plan to showcase some of the exploration skills, as well as how each weapon evolves — stay tuned![/p]

notes.title: Gameplay Optimization for Demo | HeroTest
notes.content:
Dear Players,

Thank you for playing [b]Arisen Force: HeroTest[/b] during the Steam Next Fest and for providing us with such valuable feedback!

We've noticed that :
[list]
[*]Sometimes players experienced issues when trying to pick up healing items, but trigger an unexpectedly jump, leading to unfortunate defeats in battle. 
[*]Manually picking up dropped items one by one felt inefficient.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43807037/583469187876ee2139169266776f5130b1624a85.gif[/img]
This design wasn't our original direction, 
hence we’ve updated the [b]item pickup system to trigger automatically[/b], allowing you to stay focused on the action without being interrupted by accidental jumps or tedious item collection.

Welcome to have a new experience on our Demo of HeroTest.

Looking ahead, we plan to further improve the visuals and sound effects for item pickups to enhance your experience.

Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: Showcase of Vonimir's Evolution Gameplay from Arisen Force: HeroTest
notes.content:
Hi Warriors of Vonimir and Players,

This update is divided into two exciting parts!

[b]PartI[/b]: We proudly introduce our new family member, Arisen Force: HeroTest. Get ready to embark on an incredible journey with new heroes and thrilling adventures.

[b]PartII[/b]: we're thrilled to showcase the evolution of Vonimir game mechanics, which you could have actually feeling in HeroTest. 


[h1]PartI——ArisenForce: HeroTest[/h1]

[h2][b]Overview[/b][/h2]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2951840/Arisen_Force_HeroTest/]Steam link &Demo[/url]

*In the demo version, we provide an initial experience with six heroes and theircorresponding introductory levels, offering substantial content. Each new game journey could play 3 times level.

Don't forget to add our games to your Steam wishlist to stay updated and be the first to know about our release details!

「Arisen Force: HeroTest」 is an A-RPG game featuring exquisite high-definition pixel art and engaging, stylish action combat. Enter the beautifully crafted pixel world of "HeroTest" and experience a thrilling, stylized combat adventure. Join heroes from across temporal rifts to battle the dark erosion of the void.

[previewyoutube=tfZ8h1tRDdA;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]
The game features around 6 main characters, each with their unique style levels (currently completed), also there will be a large multi-level dungeon and various smaller scenes. Players could return to a temporal altar, where they can adjust equipment, teammates, and various growth-related functionalities.

[url=https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1k6K0MM_e6oWhlN_UmAm37aLl3D_t6Br9?usp=drive_link]PressKit[/url]

[h2]PROGRESS[/h2]
We have already completed over 70% of the game, and yes, you could try our demo version to enjoy the prologue of game. This project experience has significantly helped our team grow more mature and stronger, financially healthier, and ready to start porting to consoles (PS, NS, Xbox) as soon as possible.

*Official Release Date:   STEAM-   Q3 2024(Jul-Aug) , CONSOLE-  2025

Here, we want to once again express our deepest gratitude to the backers who have supported our Vonimir project. Your support has allowed our team to maintain our valuable independence and continue forging ahead into the future. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43807037/08879507dc3ff1867ec5e5aae9fbb12163248d9f.jpg[/img]
When players complete any level and are teleported back to the Temple of Time, they can enter the garden through the door on the left. There, they can take a moment to rest and enjoy the scenery of time and space.


[h1]PartII——Evolution Battle Mechanics[/h1]

[b]Many of the outstanding features from HeroTest will be incorporated into our future Vonimir project.[/b]

[h2][b]EXECUTE[/b][/h2]

When an enemy's accumulated damage reaches a certain threshold, they will enter a weakened state, indicated by a flashing gold light. At this point, the player can approach and press F (keyboard) or the East button (controller) to execute a special finishing attack on the enemy.The execution will immediately knock down the enemy and interrupt their current action.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43807037/f71a1a82baf3df87e1cb654dc9d070d1ac56fae2.gif[/img]

[h2][b]JUST SYSTEM[/b][/h2]
[h3]JUST Cast[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43807037/9b0f910ed06559050e6c9475e9a4b2c260e1e566.gif[/img]
When the correct button is pressed at the right moment, it unleashes more powerful moves.
[h3]JUST Block[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43807037/1021d3638db8a5609a927b5855a47b332cada4a3.gif[/img]
JUST BLOCK allows parry counters to transition into more powerful follow-up attacks.
[h3]JUST Evade[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43807037/fa474186e44832fa9d45888dc35e48077e5b62b2.gif[/img]
When the player performs a dodge at the moment of being attacked, the JUST Evademechanism is triggered, resulting in different counterattack actions depending on the weapon type.

[h2][b]TALENT[/b][/h2]
Our uniquely designed talent system is the result of our bold research and development efforts. This system significantly enhances and highlights the distinctiveness and fun of each character, while the combination of skills and weapons further deepens the game's mechanics.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43807037/8f76fbb44b30b56dec16814a02a98a8fdc14c41f.jpg[/img]
[b]King's Dominion[/b]：When using a claymore to trigger a counter(Atack on Shield or Counter with Attack HitBox), it will generate a AOE impact damge which couldn't be guarded.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43807037/1e52bef6b2c237077a9c0b2e01b988ce84983d9e.gif[/img]

[h2][b]ENEMY[/b][/h2]
In the HeroTest demo, players can encounter a variety of new enemies, and we believe the bosses will be equally impressive.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43807037/13b4cc51a9fc7168a62fa12d3910ccdd3ac89a0b.gif[/img]

[h1]Summary[/h1]

"Arisen Force: HeroTest" is more than just a game—it's a symbol of our evolution, our aspirations, and our unwavering commitment to excellence. It represents the collective effort of a team that refuses to settle for mediocrity and a community that inspires us to reach new heights.

We wish to express our heartfelt thanks for being a part of this extraordinary journey. Together, we are creating something truly special, and we can't wait to share the next chapter with you.

Feel free to share the game's Steam link with everyone! 

Warm regard,
ArisenForceTeam--Lemport
